Hdfc Mid Cap - Overview:
HDFC Mid Cap Fund is an open-ended Mid Cap scheme managed by HDFC. The benchmark index is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI).

Hdfc Mid Cap - Investment Objective:
The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation/income by investing predominantly in Mid-Cap companies.

Hdfc Mid Cap - Fund House:
HDFC Mutual Fund is managed by HDFC Asset Management Company (AMC) Limited, one of India's largest and most trusted mutual fund houses.

Hdfc Mid Cap - Benchmark:
The benchmark index for HDFC Mid Cap Fund is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI).

Hdfc Mid Cap - Riskometer:
The riskometer classification for HDFC Mid Cap Fund is Very High. It carries a Very High risk profile as per regulatory risk-o-meter guidelines.

Hdfc Mid Cap - Expense Ratio:
